title: Salesforce SAML certificate metadata correction
implementation_steps: Confirm active IdP signing certificate fingerprint.
Compare vendor SAML metadata with approved IdP metadata.
Request production approval if UAT succeeds.
rollback_steps: Re-enable previous known-good signing certificate if approved.
validation_steps: SSO redirect loop no longer occurs.
Authentication failure rate returns to baseline.

title: Vault key or secret reference correction
implementation_steps: Compare active secret version in vault with application expected version.
Validate service account access to required secret path.
Update UAT application configuration to reference approved key version.
Promote to production only after validation evidence is attached.
rollback_steps: Rollback to previous known-good deployment artifact.
validation_steps: Service can retrieve secret from vault.

title: Change request pipeline failure remediation
implementation_steps: Inspect failed pipeline stage and collect error output.
Map failed stage to the related change request step.
Classify the failure as test, build, deployment, permission, or runtime.
Run the failed step in UAT with debug logging.
Apply the smallest safe fix and rerun the UAT pipeline.
Attach validation evidence to the change request before production promotion.
rollback_steps: Stop production promotion if UAT validation fails.
Rollback to previous deployment artifact if partial deployment occurred.
validation_steps: Failed pipeline stage passes in UAT.
Change request has validation evidence attached.
